name: Avanti Feeds Ltd
about: Avanti Feeds Ltd. manufactures and sells shrimp feed, and exports processed shrimp.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments [1] a) Shrimp Feed Manufacturing (82% in Q1 FY27 vs 77% in Q1 FY26): [2] [3] [4] The company is a shrimp feed manufacturer, with an estimated 51-53% market share in the domestic shrimp feed market. Its product portfolio includes Manamei, Profeed, Prostar, Titan, and High Boost, etc catering to different shrimp species and farming requirements. The company has an installed shrimp feed manufacturing capacity of 7.75 lakh MTPA, spread across 5 ISO- and BAP-certified plants.
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 23.8%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.15% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.197 Cr.
